summary.text: Jason Belton is the Democratic nominee. He is a labor official and business co-owner who was formerly operations director for the South Carolina American Federation of Labor. His stated top issues are voter rights and fair elections and workers' rights.

paragraphs.text: Vice president of the Greater Columbia Central Labor Council, co-founder of Vision Walkers and co-owner of Belton Does It Best.

sources.title: Meet the statewide candidates in South Carolina's 2026 general election
